title: Over-hyped by adv
author: tsunlife
selftext:
I don't get the hype around all these AI 'capabilities.' My experience creating a 'dream game' boils down to basic subscriptions and limits (Claude, ChatGPT, Meshy.ai), plus free animation assets from the Godot library. My conclusion: not a single paid AI will make a 3D model from a picture, even with skills. You have to spend extra tokens. And it can't even make a basic animation, even if you provide a 2D rig of all the joints. But why? Has nobody actually done this? 😏 So that's how a 'subscription' works but not tokens spending.  
(dis is how works “write trailer scenario by gpt and follow script by claud”).

comments.author: Lambisexual
comments.body: The lack of being able to create good looking humanoid characters and animation is the reason I can't commit to a singular project.
